description: This file contains the server-side logic for an online multiple-choice questionnaire (MCQ) exam page, including question loading, timer handling, and result submission.

classes.name: MCQExam
classes.description: Code-behind class for the MCQ exam ASP.NET page handling question display, user submissions, and timer operations.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles initial page load; loads questions from database based on course session variable.

methods.name: submitB_Click
methods.description: Calculates user answers, updates database with marks, and transfers to result page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and redirects to login page.

methods.name: Timer1_Tick
methods.description: Updates display based on countdown timer, triggers timeout logic when time expires.
